data.headline: Health Plan Chief Information Officer (CIO) Wisconsin and Texas Medicaid
data.about: Experienced Program Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the hospital & health care industry. Skilled in IT Strategy, Project Portfolio Management and Business Process Improvements. Strong program and project management professional with a Bachelor's degree focused Engineering from Bangalore University.

experiences.title: Health Plan Chief Information Officer (CIO) Wisconsin Medicaid - United HealthCare
experiences.subtitle: UnitedHealthcare . Full-time
experiences.caption: Jan 2024 - Present · 2 yrs

description.text:
o	Engage with RFP team to build IT sections of RFP response
o	Drive IT impact in coordination with the architecture teams
o	Present feasibility estimates to the capital steering committee
o	Create a Program Roadmap/Plan aligning to the Program level milestones and schedules
o	Facilitate platform integration with delivery partners to identify and manage cross-function/team dependencies.
o	Identify impacted cross-functional teams, negotiate for commitment
o	Collaborate with Product and Architect teams to groom Product Roadmaps (Product level Capabilities) 
o	Identify Value Streams and Release Trains
o	Be the ‘go-to’ for any required collaboration for cross-stream or internal/external coordination/planning or delivery
o	Ensure completion of Capabilities/Features on all identified streams based on the schedules and in alignment with PI Planning
o	Engage and align Engineering teams to the relevant Value Streams
o	Oversee ArtSync process to accommodate for any cross over requirements with in cross functional engineering teams
o	Negotiate with PMC (Business/Functions/IT stake holders) on any risks/issues/concerns
o	Contingency planning and mitigation (as required)
o	Status reporting to senior executives from both IT and Business

AmeriChoice (old name for Community & State) division in United HealthCare caters to the state funded Medicaid, DSNP and IFP contracts

Integration Services – Responsible for identifying feasibility on integrating any new growth or expansion initiatives as a result of new RFP award from a state on to the DIAMOND and other existing suite of applications.

Key Responsibilities
o	Participate in JAD sessions with customers and solicit requirements
o	Identify and capture Functional, Non-Functional, Reporting requirements, and Business Rules 
o	Assign and mentor function level business analysts
o	Help BAs generate Business Requirements document
o	Conduct impact analysis on vendor data extracts/reports and establish communication with respective vendors
o	Conduct requirements walk-through both to the Business and the IT Architecture/Development teams
o	Coordinate with Internal/External vendors to establish data exchange requirements (build/manage interfaces)
o	Generate UAT scenarios against the requirements/Coordinate UAT
o	Conduct UAT and Production Verification on a written behest  by the customer

o	Responsible for the project intake and delivery prioritization 
o	Forecast demand for the remaining part of the year 
o	Coordinate with the function and sub-pool owners on funding status
o	Review demand against available capacity and balance the Roster.
o	Liaison between COSMOS System Analyst team and business in conducting the feasibility analysis.
o	Responsible for project estimates and requesting funding approval
o	Derive release capacity and coordinate with the IT/release management to schedule release per customer requirement
o	Work on component matrix and develop high level implementation plan
o	Work with business and IT to establish acceptable release date
